newsitem.title: USA: Health Care REIT underwriters use option.
newsitem.headline: Health Care REIT underwriters use option.

text.p: Health Care REIT Inc said Friday the underwriters for its December 18 offering of 2.2 million common shares have exercised an over allotment option to purchase 330,000 additional common shares at a purchase price of $23.875 per share.
The company said that as a result of this exercise, the offering has been increased to 2,530,000 shares at a total purchase price of $60,403,750.
Alex Brown & Sons Inc acted as the manager of the underwriting group, and Smith Barney Inc and Everen Securities Inc were co-managers.
Net proceeds will be used to invest in additional health care properties, the company said.
